### 2026-10-07 — Hello,

**9h**

Hello,
This is my First entry, in the Past few days since Money ive been working on a project called Starbie. This is my first time working on something like that. Since its my first time im building the Starterproject. First i downloaded the KiCad programm, after that i followed the documentation. The KiCad programm is a really cool programm to design PCB board and im glad that this event showed it to me.
